# Standards

## Issue readiness

An issue is ready to pick up when it has:

- a problem statement
- an acceptance criteria checklist
- what is out of scope

## Ticket format

Every new issue has exactly these sections, in this order:

### Problem

### Acceptance criteria

### Out of scope
